q.line: And all his virtues burning in the smoky Holocaust
stanza: "I'll never see a face like yours in years of men to come
I'll never see such arms again in wrestling or in love."
And all his virtues burning in the smoky Holocaust
She took unto herself most everything her lover lost

q.line: His mama believed in the Pentecost

She got the preacher to say some words

q.line: And she told me all about the Pentecost
stanza: A young girl in a parking lot was preaching to a crowd
Singing sacred songs and reading from the Bible
Well, I told her I was lost
And she told me all about the Pentecost
And I seen that girl as the road to my survival
